fields.Name: IT47 - Transaction Group Atomicity
fields.Description: TransactionGroup atomicity over the wire: all-or-nothing on forced failure, ordering, variable passing; includes the scope-bypass pin per the register. Self-cleaning tagged fixtures. Client transport.
